system.description:
Named Unique (war hammer +2). Once per day, strike the ground: each other creature within 20ft makes a Fortitude save (Str DC) or is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

Quirk (Burrower): under open sky, you have Disadvantage on saves against being Frightened. A Dul Khagul tunnel-fighter's hammer; its last owner spent forty years below ground and refused to come up.

Monsters & Treasure, Named Uniques. Saves use DC 10 + half your level + the attribute named.
